entries.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.tx_id = "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901" RETURN from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.event_index AS event_index, t.edge_index AS edge_index, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount_usd) AS total_amount_usd LIMIT 1
USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id LIMIT 10
USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count LIMIT 1

USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.tx_id = "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901" RETURN from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.event_index AS event_index, t.edge_index AS edge_index, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" AND t.block_timestamp >= 1783738500000 AND t.block_timestamp < 1783738560000 RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.block_timestamp AS block_timestamp, from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "0x2459dedb3012d1e929edd17df26620120bdf11bf"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address {address: "0x220bbea2c59e2a1b0a71ffba694834e6822c0b52"}) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN a.address AS address, a.labels AS labels, a.risk_score AS risk_score, a.risk_level AS risk_level, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"}) WHERE NOT dst:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum IS NULL THEN "unknown" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 100000 THEN "large" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 10000 THEN "medium" ELSE "small" END AS amount_bucket, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT mid:Pool AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL RETURN src.address AS from_address, mid.address AS mid_address, dst.address AS to_address, 2 AS hops, type(r1) AS first_edge, type(r2) AS second_edge, coalesce(r1.amount_usd_sum, r1.bought_usd) AS first_amount_usd, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS second_amount_usd LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN count(a) AS count LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence, l.source_event AS source_event, l.declared_owner AS declared_owner LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(owned:Address)-[r:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT owned:Pool AND owned.address <> b.address AND a.address <> b.address RETURN a.address AS subject_address, owned.address AS linked_via_address, b.address AS counterparty_address, type(r) AS edge, coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, r.bought_usd) AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(r.tx_count, r.swap_count) AS tx_count LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) WHERE a.network <> b.network RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0xdd509c9f91f66a18802ef5b3d54c73b62ea1ca08"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, operation.tx_count AS tx_count, operation.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(operation.token_standard, "mixed") AS token_standard, operation.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (victim:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[paid:FLOWS_TO]->(pool:Pool)-[removal:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(receiver:Address) WHERE NOT victim:Pool AND receiver.address <> victim.address RETURN pool.address AS pool_address, receiver.address AS receiver_address, paid.amount_usd_sum AS paid_in_usd, removal.usd AS removed_usd, removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_added_usd, removal.usd - removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_profit_usd, removal.receiver_provided AS receiver_provided ORDER BY removed_usd DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT mid:Pool AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS exit_usd LIMIT 25 UNION MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|ADDED_LIQUIDITY]->(mid:Pool)-[r2:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, r2.usd AS exit_usd LIMIT 25
USE chain MATCH (t:Transaction {hash: "0x350065e1a55d7272de562706fdea5f48ae83cf10e468e56b2209f8cfbaaf1901"}) RETURN t.status, t.block_height, t.block_date
USE chain MATCH (b:Block {height: 79841521}) RETURN b.hash, b.block_date
USE chain MATCH (h:Head) RETURN h.height, h.age_seconds, h.warehouse_blocks_behind, h.graph_blocks_behind
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x…"})-[x:SWAPPED]->(b:Address) WHERE x.swap_count >= 2 RETURN b.address AS recipient, x.swap_count AS swap_count ORDER BY x.swap_count DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "0x…"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address {address: "0x…"}) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" AND t.kind = "internal" RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.event_index AS event_index, t.kind AS kind, t.amount AS amount, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd LIMIT 50
USE chain MATCH (t:Transaction {hash: "0x…"}) RETURN t.status, t.block_height, t.block_date
USE chain MATCH (b:Block {height: 79841521}) RETURN b.hash, b.block_date
USE chain MATCH (h:Head) RETURN h.height, h.age_seconds, h.warehouse_blocks_behind, h.graph_blocks_behind

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[s:SWAPPED]->(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS recipient, s.sold_asset AS sold_asset, s.bought_asset AS bought_asset, s.sold_usd AS sold_usd, s.bought_usd AS bought_usd, s.pools AS pools, s.strength AS strength, s.swap_count AS swap_count LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[:FLOWS_TO]->(p:Pool)-[r:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND b.address <> a.address RETURN p.address AS pool, b.address AS receiver, r.usd AS removed_usd, r.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_added_usd, r.receiver_provided AS receiver_provided LIMIT 50

USE facts MATCH (payer:Address)-[s:SWAP]->(recipient:Address) WHERE s.tx_id = "0x…" RETURN payer.address AS payer, recipient.address AS recipient, s.strength AS strength, s.reason AS reason, s.route_id AS route_id, s.sold_asset_symbol AS sold, s.sold_usd AS sold_usd, s.bought_asset_symbol AS bought, s.bought_usd AS bought_usd LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool RETURN a.address AS from_address, b.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY f.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: $from})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Address {address: $to}) WHERE t.block_date = "YYYY-MM-DD" RETURN t.block_timestamp AS block_timestamp, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd LIMIT 200
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x…"}) RETURN a.labels AS labels, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange, a.is_scam AS is_scam, a.is_victim AS is_victim, a.is_sanctioned AS is_sanctioned LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x…"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT mid:Pool AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS exit_usd LIMIT 25 UNION MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x…"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|ADDED_LIQUIDITY]->(mid:Pool)-[r2:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, r2.usd AS exit_usd LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (victim:Address {address: "0x…"})-[paid:FLOWS_TO]->(pool:Pool)-[removal:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(receiver:Address) WHERE NOT victim:Pool AND receiver.address <> victim.address RETURN pool.address AS pool_address, receiver.address AS receiver_address, paid.amount_usd_sum AS paid_in_usd, removal.usd AS removed_usd, removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_added_usd, removal.usd - removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_profit_usd, removal.receiver_provided AS receiver_provided ORDER BY removed_usd DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0x…"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, operation.tx_count AS tx_count, operation.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(operation.token_standard, "mixed") AS token_standard, operation.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (a:Address)-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN a.address AS address, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address, b.network, l.basis, l.confidence LIMIT 25
USE facts MATCH (a:Address {address: $from})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Address {address: $to}) WHERE t.block_date = "YYYY-MM-DD" RETURN t.tx_id, t.block_timestamp LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[:LINKED]-(owned:Address)-[r:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT owned:Pool AND owned.address <> b.address AND a.address <> b.address RETURN owned.address, b.address, type(r), coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, r.bought_usd) LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner, operation.tx_count AS tx_count ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (victim:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[paid:FLOWS_TO]->(pool:Pool)-[removal:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(receiver:Address) WHERE NOT victim:Pool AND receiver.address <> victim.address RETURN pool.address AS pool_address, receiver.address AS receiver_address, removal.usd AS removed_usd, removal.receiver_added_usd AS receiver_added_usd, removal.receiver_provided AS receiver_provided LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"}) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.address] AS route LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"} WHERE NOT a:Pool) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address LIMIT 50
USE topology MATCH (n:Address) RETURN n.address AS address, n.network AS network, n.labels AS labels, n.risk_score AS risk_score, n.risk_level AS risk_level LIMIT 20
USE topology MATCH (:Address)-[r:FLOWS_TO]->(:Address) RETURN r.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 20
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "corpus-address-a"})-[x:SWAPPED]->(b:Address) WHERE x.swap_count >= 2 RETURN b.address, x.swap_count LIMIT 25
